sampling.nativeRepetitions: one fresh native process per repetition, as many as the browser repetitions
sampling.preparation: one untimed buildFillMeshes call on the 1,000 requests per set; it provisions the arenas

init.window: from before one buildFillMeshes call on the set to after the fold of its last result

edit.algorithm: fisher-yates-descending over paths 0 .. paths - 1, seed + r
edit.window: from before one buildFillMeshes call on one request to after the fold of its result

sampling.cold: one call per set on a second adapter over a fresh instance created and disposed outside timing; the window includes its reserve and arena growth

renderer.call: PathMeshPipeline.prepare on the 1,000 path nodes with a cold cache, a fresh pipeline per set, on the provisioned adapter
renderer.fringeBuilder: buildPathFringe, wrapped only to count its calls and time

sampling.fold: FNV-1a 64 over the decoded results: per path in request order the status as u32 LE; on ok also V, T and the boundary pair count as u32 LE, then the position f64 bits LE, the indices u32 LE and the boundary pairs u32 LE (AL-S2 fold_decoded)
sampling.integrity: each warm-up, timed and edit call (and the OB5-SR port call) advances the fill memory epoch by exactly 1 and leaves both arena capacities and the linear memory size unchanged; natively zero allocations and unchanged storage
sampling.visibility: the page stays visible for the whole repetition
sampling.retained: every raw sample, warm-up and preparation call with its window boundaries

native.role: report-only timing; its folds are the browser oracle (OB5-V1) and its build_path records the rung mix (OB5-V6)
